Name: Normal climb -- all engines operating
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of engine thrust, aerodynamic drag and atmosphere in a steady state normal climb condition conforms to the aeroplane.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Clean or specified climb configuration | Alt[ft]: 3000 | IAS[kts]: 80 | Flaps: 0
Tolerance: ± 3 kts airspeed | ± 5% or ± 0.5 m/s (100 ft/min) R/C (Rate of Climb)

Name: Engine acceleration
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulated engine acceleration conforms to the validation data.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Approach or Landing | Alt[ft]: 2000 | IAS[kts]: 80 | Flaps: 0 | Throttle[%]: 5
Tolerance: ± 10% Ti or ± 0.25 s | ± 10% Tt (Ti: 10% response, Tt: 90% go-around power)

Name: Engine deceleration
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulated engine deceleration conforms to the aeroplane.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Ground | Alt[ft]: 755 | IAS[kts]: 0 | Flaps: 0 | Throttle[%]: 100
Tolerance: ± 10% Tt (Total time from initial throttle movement until 90% flight idle throttle movement)

Name: Pitch controller position vs force and surface position calibration
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator pitch controller position vs. pitch controller force conforms to the validation data.
Tolerance: ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% force | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% column position | ± 2º elevator (where applicable)

Name: Roll controller position vs force and surface position calibration
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator roll controller position vs. roll controller force conform to the aeroplane.
Tolerance: ± 1.3 daN (3 lbs) or ± 10% force | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% wheel position | ± 2º aileron/spoiler

Name: Rudder pedal position vs force and surface position calibration
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulator rudder pedal position vs. rudder pedal force conform to the aeroplane.
Tolerance: ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% force | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% pedal position | ± 2º rudder

Name: Rudder pedal steering calibration
Objective: To demonstrate that the rudder pedal steering conforms to the aeroplane.
Tolerance: ± 10% or ± 2° nosewheel angle or ± 10% rudder pedal position

Name: Pitch trim rate and indicator calibration
Objective: To demonstrate that the pitch trim rate and indicator calibration conform to the aeroplane.
Tolerance: ± 10% travel rate | ± 0.5 s or ± 10% time for full travel | ± 0.5 cm (0.2 in) or ± 10% cockpit trim control

Name: Alignment of cockpit throttle lever vs selected engine parameter
Objective: Record cockpit throttle, propeller and mixture lever positions with simulator engine parameters.
Tolerance: ± 5° TLA or ± 3% N1 or ± 0.03 EPR or ± 3% torque; ± 2 cm for non-angular propeller levers

Name: Power change dynamics
Objective: Power change from thrust for approach or level flight to maximum continuous or go-around power. Time history of uncontrolled free response for at least 5 s before initiation to completion + 15 s.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Approach | Alt[ft]: 4000 | IAS[kts]: 90 | Flaps: 1 | Throttle[%]: 50 | Temperature[C]: 15
Tolerance: ± 3 kt airspeed | ± 30 m (100 ft) altitude | ± 1.5° or ± 20 % pitch angle

Name: Flap change dynamics
Objective: Time history of uncontrolled free response for at least 5 s before initiation of reconfiguration change to completion + 15 s.
Tolerance: ± 3 kts airspeed | ± 30 m (100 ft) altitude | ± 1.5º or ± 20% pitch angle

Name: Spoiler / speedbrake change dynamics
Objective: Time history of uncontrolled free response for at least 5 s before initiation of reconfiguration change to completion + 15 s. Extension and retraction.
Tolerance: ± 3 kts airspeed | ± 30 m (100 ft) altitude | ± 1.5º or ± 20% pitch angle

Name: Gear change dynamics
Objective: Time history of uncontrolled free response for at least 5 s before initiation of configuration change to completion + 15 s.
Tolerance: ± 3 kts airspeed | ± 30 m (100 ft) altitude | ± 1.5º or ± 20% pitch angle (± 2º for FNPT/BITD)

Name: Longitudinal trim
Objective: Steady-state wings level trim with thrust for level flight.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Cruise, approach, and landing
Tolerance: ± 1º elevator | ± 0.5º stabilizer | ± 1º pitch angle | ± 5% net thrust

Name: Longitudinal manoeuvring stability (stick force/g)
Objective: To demonstrate that the simulation of manoeuvring stability (stick force per g) conforms to the validation data.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Cruise, approach, and landing
Tolerance: ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% pitch controller force | Alternative: ± 1º or ± 10% change of elevator

Name: Longitudinal static stability
Objective: Data for at least two speeds above and two speeds below trim speed.
Tolerance: ± 2.2 daN (5 lbs) or ± 10% pitch controller force | Alternative: ± 1° or ± 10% change of elevator

Name: Approach-to-stall characteristics (Stall warning)
Objective: To record the aircraft's approach-to-stall characteristics.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Approach | Alt[ft]: 4000 | IAS[kts]: 90 | Flaps: 0 | Temperature[C]: 15 | Throttle[%]: 80
Tolerance: ± 3 kt stall warning speed | ± 2° angle of attack at initial buffet | ± 2° pitch
column9: angle of attack and bank | ± 10% or ± 5 lb stick force where applicable

Name: Phugoid dynamics
Objective: Test should include at least three full cycles or that necessary to determine time to 1/2 or double amplitude.
Tolerance: ± 10% period | ± 10% time to 1/2 or double amplitude or ± 0.02 damping ratio

Name: Short-period dynamics
Objective: To demonstrate that the short-period dynamic characteristics conform to the aeroplane.
Tolerance: ± 1.5° pitch angle or ± 2°/s pitch rate | ± 0.1 g normal acceleration

Name: Minimum control speed air (Vmca or Vmcl)
Objective: Minimum control speed air per applicable airworthiness standard, or low speed engine inoperative handling in the air.
Tolerance: ± 3 kt airspeed

Name: Roll response (rate)
Objective: Test with normal roll control displacement (about 30% of maximum control wheel).
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Cruise and approach or landing
Tolerance: ± 10% or ± 2°/s roll rate | FS: ± 10% or ± 1.3 daN (3 lb) roll controller force

Name: Step input of cockpit roll controller (roll overshoot)
Objective: Wings level, apply step roll input (~1/3 wheel travel). At 20° to 30° bank, abruptly return to neutral and allow at least 10 s free response.
Tolerance: ± 10% or ± 2° bank angle

Name: Spiral stability
Objective: Aeroplane data averaged from multiple tests may be used. Test for both directions.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Cruise and approach or landing
Tolerance: Correct trend and ± 2° or ± 10% bank angle in 20 s (or correct trend and ± 2° aileron)

Name: Engine inoperative trim
Objective: Trim an engine failure condition. 2nd segment climb at take-off thrust; approach or landing at level flight thrust.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: 2nd segment climb and approach or landing
Tolerance: ± 1º rudder angle or ± 1º tab angle or equivalent pedal | ± 2º sideslip angle

Name: Rudder response
Objective: Test with step input at approximately 25% of full rudder pedal throw with stability augmentation OFF.
Tolerance: ± 2 deg/s or ± 10% yaw rate | ± 10% heading change

Name: Dutch roll (yaw damper OFF)
Objective: Test for at least six cycles with stability augmentation OFF.
Initial Conditions: Flt cond: Cruise and approach or landing
Tolerance: ± 0.5 s or ± 10% period | ± 10% time to 1/2 or double amplitude or ± 0.02 damping ratio

Name: Steady state sideslip
Objective: Snapshot tests using at least two rudder positions in each direction, one near maximum allowable rudder.
Tolerance: ± 2° bank angle | ± 1° sideslip angle | ± 10% or ± 2° aileron | ± 10% or ± 1.3 daN wheel force | ± 10% or ± 2.2 daN pedal force
